concurrency_and_state: PVP.lose(Player, TYPE_LOSE_PVP) is synchronized on the PVP instance, but PVP constructor publishes `this` to PVPManager.gI().addPVP(this) and sets p1.pvp/p2.pvp before subclass constructors (ThachDau) initialize gold fields and deduct gold (src/models/matches/PVP.java:24-28, src/models/matches/pvp/ThachDau.java:19-27).

TraThu.start() schedules super.start() asynchronously after 3000ms on GameLoopManager; if either player disconnects or starts disposing before 3s, the scheduled lambda silently skips super.start() without calling dispose(), stranding the TraThu object in PVPManager and player.pvp (src/models/matches/pvp/TraThu.java:39-46).

BlackBallWar.win() spawns a virtual thread (BlackBallWar-RewardWorker) iterating player.clan.members without synchronization while dispatching async DB updates and mutating onlinePlayer.rewardBlackBall concurrently (src/models/phoban/BlackBallWar.java:98-119).

SuperRank.init() spawns a per-match virtual thread (SuperRank-Worker) that loops until Maintenance.isRunning || !isCompeting; Maintenance.isRunning exits the loop without calling dispose(), potentially leaving zone.isCompeting = true (src/models/tournament/super_rank/SuperRank.java:88-105).

DeathOrAliveArena uses CopyOnWriteArrayList for binhChon spectators, but traThuongHatMit() reads/mutates pl.inventory.gold, pl.binhChonPlayer, and pl.binhChonHatMit across players without per-player synchronization (src/models/tournament/DeathOrAliveArena.java:65, 222-287).

DestronGas, RedRibbonHQ, SnakeWay, and TreasureUnderSea call finish(); dispose(); in update() upon timeout without returning, causing the remainder of update() to run on a disposed instance with clan == null (src/models/phoban/DestronGas.java:60-112, RedRibbonHQ.java:208-240, SnakeWay.java:63-95, TreasureUnderSea.java:62-137).
cross_module_questions: How does Controller dispatch `-59` to PVPService.controllerThachDau, and does Player.inventory.subGold clamp at 0 or permit negative gold if concurrent matches occur?

Does Zone.getPlayers() return a thread-safe snapshot or the live mutable list? Several dungeon loops (DestronGas, RedRibbonHQ, SnakeWay, TreasureUnderSea) iterate zone.getPlayers() with enhanced-for loops during update() and reward distribution.

Are DestronGas, RedRibbonHQ, SnakeWay, and TreasureUnderSea instances pooled and reused across runs by a manager? If so, unreset fields like TreasureUnderSea.isRecordUpdated and DestronGas.callBoss will break subsequent runs.
How do SuperRankDAO.getRank and SuperRankDAO.updatePlayer handle concurrent rank swaps, and does Rival boss constructor or Boss.dispose() clean up anything else?
Where are BossesData.REST_24_H (86400000) and BossesData.DEATH_BEAM / RAITI / *_NEW consumed, and is REST_24_H converted from seconds or milliseconds in Boss?

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Calls PlayerDAO.updatePlayerAsync(player) for online players and PlayerDAO.updateBlackBallReward(m.id, (byte) star) for offline clan members inside an unsynchronized virtual thread iterating clan.members.
db_redis_touchpoints.target: MySQL via PlayerDAO (player / black ball reward)

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Calls clan.update() synchronously inside TreasureUnderSea.update() when a new BDKB level/time record is set.
Calls blocking PlayerDAO.updatePlayer(player) synchronously on the arena update thread inside champion().

Calls SuperRankDAO.getRank((int) rivalId) and SuperRankDAO.updatePlayer(...) synchronously in win()/lose() without cross-player DB transaction or lock, allowing rank-swap race conditions across concurrent matches. Note also cast `(int) rivalId` truncates long ID.

findings.impact: Allows client to trigger ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, accept mismatched gold wagers via race/overwrite on idMark, or double-enter ThachDau matches without mutual locking.
findings.root_cause: sendInvitePVP(Player, byte selectGold) indexes GOLD_CHALLENGE[selectGold] with no bounds check; idMark.idPlayThachDau and idMark.goldThachDau can be overwritten by a third player before acceptPVP; acceptPVP checks pl.pvp == null and gold without synchronizing on pl and plMap.
findings.title: Unvalidated selectGold index and unsynchronized wager/match state in PVPService

findings.impact: Concurrent update()/lose() on PVPManager can observe goldThachDau == 0 and goldReward == 0 or refund gold before constructor deducts it.
findings.root_cause: PVP constructor invokes start() and PVPManager.gI().addPVP(this) before subclass ThachDau initializes goldThachDau/goldReward and calls subGold().
findings.title: Unsafe publication of ThachDau in PVP constructor before wager fields and gold deduction complete

findings.impact: Players lose 1 gem and trigger the 5-minute revenge cooldown even when the target cannot be challenged (offline, in a dungeon, or full zone).
findings.root_cause: acceptRevenge() deducts 1 gem and sets lastTimeRevenge at lines 265-267 before verifying enemy != null, pvp == null, and map joinability at lines 269-285; TraThu.start() also rejects dungeon maps after construction.
findings.title: Gem and cooldown consumed before validating target availability in TraThu revenge

findings.impact: Memory leak in PVPManager and permanently locked player.pvp state if either player disconnects during the 3-second TraThu delay, plus potential ConcurrentModificationException on p1.enemies.
findings.root_cause: TraThu.start() schedules super.start() 3s later on GameLoopManager; if the disconnect check fails, dispose() is never called. sendResult() iterates and removes from p1.enemies without synchronization and calls p1.equals(plLose) without null checks.
findings.title: TraThu 3-second scheduled start leaks PVP on disconnect and iterates p1.enemies unsafely

findings.impact: Leaks DHVT instances in PVPManager and leaves player.pvp referencing an inactive DHVT after SuperRank or The23rdMartialArtCongress ends.
findings.root_cause: DHVT sets p1.pvp/p2.pvp and registers itself in PVPManager via super(), and incorrectly passes TYPE_PVP.THACH_DAU instead of DAI_HOI_VO_THUAT; SuperRank and The23rdMartialArtCongress instantiate `new DHVT(...)` without retaining or disposing it in finish()/endChallenge()/dispose().
findings.title: DHVT PVP objects leaked by SuperRank and The23rdMartialArtCongress and tagged as THACH_DAU

findings.impact: Post-timeout update() execution continues on disposed dungeons (clan == null, isOpened == false), risking NullPointerException, spurious boss spawns (DestronGas), or resetting flags (SnakeWay.allMobsDead, RedRibbonHQ.winDT).
findings.root_cause: All four pho ban update() methods execute finish(); dispose(); when expired without returning, falling through to mob/boss checks and notifications in the same tick.
findings.title: Missing early return after finish()/dispose() in all four pho ban update() loops

findings.impact: Boss CADICH HP overflows int to a negative number when SnakeWay level >= 114 (e.g., level 114 computes 64*64*538888 = 2,207,285,248 > Integer.MAX_VALUE), and mob damage/HP calculations also use int arithmetic before assignment.
findings.root_cause: `60000000 + (long)((level - 50) * (level - 50) * 538888)` multiplies three ints before casting to long, and mob dame/maxHp use `(int) level * 1000 * mob.tempId * 12`.
findings.title: Numeric int overflow in SnakeWay CADICH HP and mob stats scaling

findings.impact: On pooled/reused TreasureUnderSea instances, clan clear records can only be updated once per server lifetime.
findings.root_cause: isRecordUpdated is set to true when clearing BDKB (line 107) but is never reset back to false in dispose().
findings.title: TreasureUnderSea.isRecordUpdated is never reset in dispose()

findings.impact: Concurrent BlackBallWar wins or clan roster modifications can cause ConcurrentModificationException, double rewards, or missed kicks (updatePlayer does not check finishBlackBallWar).
findings.root_cause: win() spawns an unsynchronized virtual thread iterating player.clan.members while mutating onlinePlayer.rewardBlackBall; update() swallows all exceptions silently and updatePlayer() ignores zone.finishBlackBallWar.
findings.title: Unsynchronized clan member iteration and missing finish guard in BlackBallWar.win()

findings.impact: Concurrent SuperRank matches against the same rival can duplicate or corrupt ranks, and server maintenance exit leaves zone.isCompeting stuck true without deducting tickets/gems.
findings.root_cause: win()/lose() perform non-atomic read-modify-write via SuperRankDAO.getRank/updatePlayer without locking; lose() uses stale rankWin/rankLose from match start; Maintenance.isRunning breaks run() loop without calling dispose(). Also `(int) rivalId` truncates long ID at line 156.
findings.title: Rank-swap race condition, ID truncation, and maintenance leak in SuperRank

findings.impact: Spectators who bet exclusively on the losing side keep non-zero binhChonPlayer/binhChonHatMit counters after the match; integer overflow on total votes > 2386; unsynchronized gold mutation.
findings.root_cause: traThuongHatMit() only resets binhChonPlayer and binhChonHatMit inside the winning bettor branch (`if (cuoc > 0)`), and computes `(cuocBaHatMit + cuocPlayer) * 900_000L` in int before long multiplication without locking spectator Player instances.
findings.title: Stale losing-bet counters and int overflow in DeathOrAliveArena.traThuongHatMit()

findings.impact: NullPointerException if player or boss is null during update() or endChallenge(), plus inflated timeTotal (180 - 129 = 51s minimum) and blocking DB update in DeathOrAliveArena.champion().
findings.root_cause: DeathOrAliveArena.update() calls boss.isDie() without null check and adds (180 - time) when ready() sets time = 129; The23rdMartialArtCongress.endChallenge() dereferences player.zone and player.isPKDHVT before null-checking player.
findings.title: NullPointerException and timer mismatch in DeathOrAliveArena and The23rdMartialArtCongress

findings.impact: REST_24_H is 1000x larger than other REST_* constants (86400000 vs REST_1_H = 3600); static Util.nextInt(5000, 10000) fixes skill cooldowns at class load time; TUAN_LOC contains profanity in chat text.
findings.root_cause: REST_24_H is defined in milliseconds (86400000) alongside second-based constants (REST_1_H = 3600); BossData fields initialize cooldowns with static Util.nextInt() once; TUAN_LOC line 2440 has inappropriate chat text.
findings.title: BossesData unit mismatch (REST_24_H), static-evaluated random cooldowns, and profanity in TUAN_LOC

module_summary: Batch server_boss_dungeon_pvp__p05 covers static boss definitions (BossesData), 1v1 PVP match types and invitation/revenge service (PVP, PVPService, DHVT, LuyenTap, PKCommeson, ThachDau, TraThu, TOP, TYPE_PVP, TYPE_LOSE_PVP), clan/timed dungeons (BlackBallWar, DestronGas, MajinBuu14H, RedRibbonHQ, SnakeWay, TreasureUnderSea), and arena/tournament controllers (DeathOrAliveArena, SuperRank, SuperRankBuilder, The23rdMartialArtCongress). Key risks include missing early returns after dungeon dispose(), PVP constructor publication and wager races, leaked DHVT PVP objects in tournaments, int overflows in SnakeWay/DeathOrAliveArena, and non-atomic SuperRank rank swaps.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Reads byte action, byte type (3=ThachDau, 4=LuyenTap), int playerId from client Message.reader().
Writes byte type (3 or 4), int (int) pl.id, int goldThachDau (or 0 for practice), UTF challenge prompt to plMap.sendMessage(msg).
Dispatches gold bet selection menu (1000/10000/100000) and 1-gem revenge confirmation dialog to client.
Updates client VS HUD and PK state at start and end of tournament bouts.
